messages:
alex: Morning — quick async. What I did: fixed microloop scheduling bug that was causing ~30–50ms tail spikes on x86 nodes; reduced 99p tail by ~6% in local perf. Blockers: flaky kv-eviction unit test (fails under load), and my CR for continuous-batcher still needs one more review. Today: will push CR, run a 3-node perf sweep at 512 tokens, and start a small canary for the new slot allocator.

maria: nice! can you paste the perf numbers? and which CR is that (link)?

alex: perf run (local):
```
512 tokens, batch size 8
old: p50 28ms p95 120ms p99 410ms
new: p50 26ms p95 115ms p99 385ms
```
CR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7245 — main change is deferred-slot reclaiming + jitter.

jon: re: kv-eviction tests — saw similar flakiness last week. suspect race when evict and warmup overlap. can you add an extra single-threaded eviction path check? I can take a look after standup.

alex: yeah i'll add a deterministic test to reproduce; thanks. question: who can +1 the CR today? need one more reviewer.

sophia: I can +1 after a quick pass. can you add a short description of the new metric? also tag the perf numbers in the PR.

alex: will do. also adding a small smoke script to validate p95/p99 across different seq lengths.

lee: heads-up — infra will run the 3-node sweep at 10:30 PT; i'll reserve nodes. ping me when the canary is ready and i'll flip routing for 5% traffic.

alex: perfect, thanks lee. i'll post the canary details and logs once it's up.

deploy-bot: canary deployment queued by lee for runtime-canary-2026-04-01-10:30 — status: pending

maria: quick question — do we want to enable prefix caching in the canary? might mask the impact of the new slot allocator.

jon: good call. run with cache off for one sweep, then on for a second. that'll show both extremes.

alex: agreed. plan: sweep A (cache off), sweep B (cache on). will attach logs and a diff of token-level cost. ETA: 2 hours. Anyone object?

sophia: no objections. thanks for the heads-up.

lee: all good. ping here when ready and i'll trigger the canary.

alex: will do. blocking item for today—if the eviction test reproduces I'll need a hand bisecting a7b3c -> c9f2e to find the regression. tagging jon here.

jon: i'll take the bisect if it reproduces. post repro steps.

alex: added repro steps to the PR and included a minimal curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://local-runtime/evict -d '{"key": "hot_prefix"}'
```

maria: thanks. small nit — can you include the seed for the random eviction scheduler so we can reproduce deterministically?

alex: yes doing that now.

sophia: quick FYI — I'll be OOO after 3pm PT but can review PRs until then.

lee: noted. good luck with the canary.

alex: thanks team — will report back here with sweep summaries and canary logs.
